EmailTemplate.name: Checking In With New Products (Accounts)
EmailTemplate.subject: Checking In...
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Hope you’re well, I just wanted to quickly check-in to see if you’re in need of a re-order to replenish our Zig-Zag and Clipper products. As you know, we continually refresh our product offerings so I’d be happy to discuss our current line-up as well as ongoing monthly promotions you may have missed since your last order.
Please let me know what might be a good time to connect by phone. And in case it’s helpful, I’ve attached our latest brand guide to review.
Best Regards, Zig-Zag Alternative Team
